description: Original bounded algebra algorithm with independent finite checks
forward: Execute independent oracle and boundary assertions
inverse: A successful run excludes any exercised mismatch between production and independent oracle, accepted invalid fixture, or failure of a named residual/dimension assertion. It does not exclude defects outside the finite fixture set.

An observed passing transcript admits all production programs agreeing on exercised observations, including programs wrong on unseen inputs. The original and any implementation with identical fixture outputs are indistinguishable by this harness.
limitations: Partial syntax; finite tests do not prove universal correctness; no allocator failure injection; no executable surrogate
